name: ASCII Glyphscape
description: Turns any picture or video into an ASCII-art wallpaper theme for Orca: real colour, blue halftone, dot matrix or diamond LED styles, fifteen character sets (from Braille and Dither to Film and Drift), colour grading, a subject isolator and looping motion (hover glow, ripples, scanline, glitch, breathe). Everything is set in Settings > Plugins > ASCII Glyphscape; each change renders the "ASCII Glyphscape Dark" and "ASCII Glyphscape Light" themes again, delivered by the ASCII Glyphscape Output plugin.

commands.title: ASCII Glyphscape: Choose image or video…
ASCII Glyphscape: Use the sample picture

settings.title: Source: picture or video
settings.description: Full path of a picture (JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, GIF) or a video (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV). Use the command "ASCII Glyphscape: Choose image or video" to pick one with a file dialog. Videos become video wallpapers.

settings.title: Source: keep in view when cropping
Style: character set
settings.description: Braille and Dither read the picture at twice the grid’s detail. Film, Particle and Drift follow Style: effect strength. The Mesh style draws its own diamonds and does not use a character set.

settings.title: Style: custom characters
settings.description: Used when the character set is Custom: from empty or darkest to fullest, at least two characters. Start with a space for empty cells.

settings.title: Style: cell size (px at 1080p)
settings.description: Size of one character cell on a 1080-pixel-high screen; it scales with the resolution, so the look is the same on every screen.

settings.title: Style: font
settings.description: A font family name (for example "JetBrains Mono") or the full path of a .ttf/.otf file.

settings.title: Style: effect strength
settings.description: For the character sets with an effect. Film: colour grade, halation and grain. Particle: how many particles. Drift: how long the trails are.

settings.title: Style: drift direction
settings.description: Which way the Drift character set smears bright cells.

settings.title: Colour: isolate subject (flat background)
settings.description: Treats colours close to the top-left corner of the picture as background and draws them flat. Best for a subject on a plain backdrop.

settings.title: Colour: isolate threshold
settings.description: How different from the backdrop a colour must be to count as subject.

settings.title: Colour: ink tint
settings.description: A hex colour that every character is tinted toward (duotone). Empty: none.

settings.title: Colour: background
settings.description: Hex colour behind the characters.

settings.title: Colour: accent
settings.description: Hex colour of the glow in the motion effects, also used for Orca’s highlights.

settings.title: Motion: animation
settings.description: Anything but Off makes a looping video wallpaper (needs ffmpeg). Orca plays it while its window is focused and shows the still picture otherwise.
enumLabels: Hover: a wandering glow with a trail

settings.title: Motion: trail
settings.description: How long the glow lingers; higher is longer.

settings.title: Motion: glitch characters in the glow
Motion: video start (seconds)
settings.description: For a video source: where the wallpaper clip starts.

settings.title: Motion: video end (seconds)
settings.description: For a video source: where it ends. 0: the end of the video. Orca plays at most 60 seconds.

settings.title: Output: resolution
settings.description: Orca accepts pictures up to 2 MB and videos up to 1920 × 1200 and 8 MB; a picture that would be larger is drawn again at a smaller size.

settings.title: Output: wallpaper strength
settings.description: How strongly Orca paints the wallpaper. Orca’s own Background Opacity (Settings > Appearance) must also be below 1 for the wallpaper to show at all.

settings.title: Output: random seed
settings.description: Changes the grain and the glitch pattern while keeping everything else.

settings.title: Sidebar: tone
settings.description: Orca cannot blur or see through its sidebars; this sets how the solid sidebars sit against the wallpaper’s colours.

settings.title: Sidebar: accent tint
settings.description: Mixes the accent colour into the sidebars.

settings.title: Advanced: render when a setting changes
settings.description: Off: render only with "ASCII Glyphscape: Render now".

settings.title: Advanced: Python with Pillow
settings.description: The renderer needs Python 3 with Pillow (python-pillow), and ffmpeg for motion and video.

settings.title: Advanced: theme output folder
settings.description: Where the themes are written. When this plugin’s folder is read-only (installed from Git) a small theme plugin is made in your data folder and loaded into Orca for you.
